summary.en: A new girl named Ai Haibara transfers into Conan's class. Conan is apathetic, but the rest of the Detective Boys are excited. She acts rather cold and reserved when the Detective Boys try to befriend her, and Genta notices she's looking at Conan suspiciously. She tells them she lives at Beika 2-chōme, 22-banchi, which Conan deduces is right near his house, but can't think of any candidate houses or apartments where a Haibara family has lived.

suspects: Akira Shirakura, Michio Morioka, Kazuhiro Hosoya, and the Black Organization
suspectsZh: 白仓晃、森冈道夫、细谷和宏与黑衣组织
